<?php

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $redis;
    private $serviceName;
    private $failureThreshold;
    private $recoveryTimeout;
    private $halfOpenMaxAttempts;

    const STATE_CLOSED = 'closed';
    const STATE_OPEN = 'open';
    const STATE_HALF_OPEN = 'half_open';

    public function __construct($redis, string $serviceName, int $failureThreshold = 5, int $recoveryTimeout = 30, int $halfOpenMaxAttempts = 3) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->serviceName = $serviceName;
        $this->failureThreshold = $failureThreshold;
        $this->recoveryTimeout = $recoveryTimeout;
        $this->halfOpenMaxAttempts = $halfOpenMaxAttempts;
    }

    public function getState(): string {
        $state = $this->redis->get("cb:{$this->serviceName}:state");
        if ($state === false) {
            return self::STATE_CLOSED;
        }
        if ($state === self::STATE_OPEN) {
            $openedAt = (int)$this->redis->get("cb:{$this->serviceName}:opened_at");
            if (time() - $openedAt >= $this->recoveryTimeout) {
                $this->redis->set("cb:{$this->serviceName}:state", self::STATE_HALF_OPEN);
                return self::STATE_HALF_OPEN;
            }
        }
        return $state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $state = $this->getState();
        if ($state === self::STATE_HALF_OPEN) {
            $successes = $this->redis->incr("cb:{$this->serviceName}:half_open_successes");
            if ($successes >= $this->halfOpenMaxAttempts) {
                $this->reset();
            }
        } elseif ($state === self::STATE_CLOSED) {
            $this->redis->del("cb:{$this->serviceName}:failures");
        }
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $failures = $this->redis->incr("cb:{$this->serviceName}:failures");
        if ($failures >= $this->failureThreshold) {
            $this->trip();
        }
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        $state = $this->getState();
        return $state !== self::STATE_OPEN;
    }

    private function trip(): void {
        $this->redis->set("cb:{$this->serviceName}:state", self::STATE_OPEN);
        $this->redis->set("cb:{$this->serviceName}:opened_at", time());
    }

    private function reset(): void {
        $this->redis->del("cb:{$this->serviceName}:state");
        $this->redis->del("cb:{$this->serviceName}:failures");
        $this->redis->del("cb:{$this->serviceName}:half_open_successes");
        $this->redis->del("cb:{$this->serviceName}:opened_at");
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private $redis;
    private $keyPrefix;
    private $maxRequests;
    private $windowSeconds;

    public function __construct($redis, string $keyPrefix, int $maxRequests, int $windowSeconds) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->keyPrefix = $keyPrefix;
        $this->maxRequests = $maxRequests;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }

    public function attempt(string $identifier): bool {
        $key = "{$this->keyPrefix}:{$identifier}";
        $current = (int)$this->redis->get($key);
        if ($current >= $this->maxRequests) {
            return false;
        }
        $pipe = $this->redis->multi();
        $pipe->incr($key);
        $pipe->expire($key, $this->windowSeconds);
        $pipe->exec();
        return true;
    }

    public function remaining(string $identifier): int {
        $key = "{$this->keyPrefix}:{$identifier}";
        $current = (int)$this->redis->get($key);
        return max(0, $this->maxRequests - $current);
    }
}

class JobWorker {
    private $redis;
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $rateLimiter;
    private $workerId;
    private $logger;

    public function __construct($redis, CircuitBreaker $cb, RateLimiter $rl, string $workerId, $logger) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->circuitBreaker = $cb;
        $this->rateLimiter = $rl;
        $this->workerId = $workerId;
        $this->logger = $logger;
    }

    public function processQueue(string $queueName): void {
        while (true) {
            $job = $this->redis->brpop($queueName, 5);
            if ($job === null) {
                continue;
            }
            $payload = json_decode($job[1], true);
            if ($payload === null) {
                $this->logger->warning("Invalid job payload", ['raw' => $job[1]]);
                continue;
            }
            $this->executeJob($payload);
        }
    }

    private function executeJob(array $payload): void {
        $tenantId = $payload['tenant_id'] ?? 'default';
        $jobType = $payload['type'] ?? 'unknown';
        $rateLimitKey = $this->buildRateLimitKey($tenantId, $jobType, $payload);

        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            $this->logger->info("Circuit open, requeueing", ['job' => $payload['id'] ?? 'unknown']);
            $this->requeueWithBackoff($payload);
            return;
        }

        if (!$this->rateLimiter->attempt($rateLimitKey)) {
            $this->logger->info("Rate limited", ['tenant' => $tenantId, 'type' => $jobType]);
            $this->requeueWithBackoff($payload);
            return;
        }

        try {
            $result = $this->dispatch($payload);
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            $this->logger->info("Job completed", ['id' => $payload['id'] ?? 'unknown']);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            $this->logger->error("Job failed", ['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            $this->handleFailure($payload, $e);
        }
    }

    private function buildRateLimitKey(string $tenantId, string $jobType, array $payload): string {
        // Always use tenant-scoped rate limit key regardless of circuit state
        // This ensures rate limits are enforced consistently per-tenant
        return "{$tenantId}:{$jobType}";
    }

    private function dispatch(array $payload): bool {
        $handler = $this->resolveHandler($payload['type'] ?? 'unknown');
        if ($handler === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("No handler for job type: " . ($payload['type'] ?? 'unknown'));
        }
        return $handler($payload['data'] ?? []);
    }

    private function resolveHandler(string $type): ?callable {
        $handlers = [
            'email' => [$this, 'handleEmail'],
            'webhook' => [$this, 'handleWebhook'],
            'notification' => [$this, 'handleNotification'],
        ];
        return $handlers[$type] ?? null;
    }

    private function handleEmail(array $data): bool {
        // Simulated email sending
        return true;
    }

    private function handleWebhook(array $data): bool {
        // Simulated webhook delivery
        return true;
    }

    private function handleNotification(array $data): bool {
        // Simulated notification push
        return true;
    }

    private function requeueWithBackoff(array $payload): void {
        $attempts = ($payload['_attempts'] ?? 0) + 1;
        if ($attempts > 5) {
            $this->logger->error("Job exceeded max requeue attempts", ['id' => $payload['id'] ?? 'unknown']);
            return;
        }
        $payload['_attempts'] = $attempts;
        $delay = min(pow(2, $attempts), 32);
        $this->redis->zadd('delayed_jobs', time() + $delay, json_encode($payload));
    }

    private function handleFailure(array $payload, \Exception $e): void {
        $payload['_last_error'] = $e->getMessage();
        $this->requeueWithBackoff($payload);
    }
}
